REIT Growth and Income Select Portfolio, Series 7
FT 772
FT 772 is a series of a unit investment trust, the FT Series. FT 772
consists of a single portfolio known as REIT Growth and Income Select
Portfolio, Series 7 (the "Trust").
The date of this prospectus is October 15, 2003
